iast: oṃ pūrṇam adaḥ pūrṇam idaṃ pūrṇāt pūrṇam udacyate

tr.text: Om ! That (Brahman) is infinite, and this (universe) is infinite. The infinite proceeds from the infinite. (Then) taking the infinitude of the infinite (universe), It remains as the infinite (Brahman) alone. Om ! Peace ! Peace ! Peace !
